91e53285dfee54a08f652a09e3840f60093c7be8.summary: Ars Technica news piece (published 2017-01-18) on Fruitfly, Mac malware that Malwarebytes reported. It captures screenshots and webcam images, collects information on devices on the same network, and can connect to them. The report says it seems to target biomedical research centers and may have circulated for at least two years. How machines get infected is unclear. Some of its code components predate OS X.
